data.title: Password Spraying Against Privileged Accounts
data.summary: Multiple privileged accounts experienced repeated authentication failures.
data.root_cause: A weak password was used on an externally accessible account.
data.outcome: One account was compromised. No evidence of privilege escalation or data exfiltration was found.
lessons_learned: Enforce MFA on externally accessible accounts

data.title: Phishing Campaign Targeting Finance Staff
data.summary: Finance employees received convincing emails directing them to a fraudulent Microsoft 365 sign-in page.
data.root_cause: An attacker used a lookalike domain to harvest employee credentials.
data.outcome: Two credentials were exposed but MFA prevented account takeover.

data.title: Malware Detected on Sales Laptop
indicators: Outbound connection to known malicious IP
data.summary: Endpoint protection detected a malicious executable on a sales employee's laptop.
data.root_cause: The user downloaded a fake PDF utility from an untrusted website.
data.outcome: Malware was contained to a single endpoint with no confirmed lateral movement.

data.title: Suspicious PowerShell Activity
data.summary: A server generated an alert for encoded PowerShell execution under an administrator account.
data.root_cause: A compromised service account was used to execute a malicious script.
data.outcome: The attacker executed commands but did not obtain persistent access.

data.title: Ransomware Attempt on File Server
data.summary: Endpoint protection detected behaviour consistent with ransomware encryption on a shared file server.
data.root_cause: A compromised workstation attempted to access shared folders using stolen credentials.
data.outcome: Approximately 120 files were encrypted before containment. Backups allowed full recovery.

data.title: Exposed Cloud Storage Bucket
data.summary: A cloud storage bucket containing internal documents was discovered with public read access.
data.root_cause: A deployment template applied overly permissive storage permissions.
data.outcome: The bucket was publicly accessible for approximately six hours. No confirmed bulk download was identified.

data.title: Brute Force Against VPN Gateway
data.summary: The corporate VPN was targeted by an automated credential attack.
data.root_cause: Internet-facing VPN authentication allowed excessive login attempts.
data.outcome: No successful authentication was identified.

data.title: SQL Injection on Customer Portal
data.summary: Application monitoring detected attempted SQL injection against a customer-facing search function.
data.root_cause: A legacy endpoint constructed database queries using unsanitized user input.
data.outcome: The vulnerability was exploited to retrieve limited non-sensitive records. No administrative database access occurred.
lessons_learned: Include security testing in application releases

data.title: Suspicious Login from Impossible Location
indicators: Two geographically distant logins within 18 minutes
data.summary: Identity monitoring detected an impossible-travel event for an employee account.
data.root_cause: The user's password had been reused on an external website that suffered a credential leak.
data.outcome: The attacker accessed email for approximately 20 minutes but did not alter account permissions.

data.title: DNS Tunnelling Detected
indicators: Repeated requests to newly registered domain
data.summary: Network monitoring identified DNS traffic consistent with command-and-control tunnelling.
data.root_cause: A developer workstation was infected with an information-stealing malware family.
data.outcome: Small amounts of browser metadata were transmitted before containment.
lessons_learned: Restrict endpoint access to untrusted domains

data.title: Lost Corporate Laptop
data.summary: An employee reported a company laptop missing after business travel.
data.root_cause: The laptop was left unattended in a public area.
data.outcome: No evidence of data access was found. Full-disk encryption protected stored data.

data.title: Malicious USB Device Connected
data.summary: An employee connected an unknown USB device containing a malicious executable.
data.root_cause: The device was found in a company car park and connected out of curiosity.
data.outcome: Execution was blocked before malware established persistence.

data.title: Web Server Defacement
data.summary: The public website was modified by an unauthorised user and displayed attacker-controlled content.
data.root_cause: An outdated content management system plugin contained a known vulnerability.
data.outcome: The website was unavailable for 34 minutes. No customer database access was identified.
lessons_learned: Monitor web directories for unexpected files

data.title: Insider Data Exfiltration Attempt
data.summary: A user attempted to collect and upload a large volume of internal documents shortly before leaving the company.
data.root_cause: The employee intentionally attempted to retain company information after their resignation.
data.outcome: Approximately 1.8 GB of data was staged but the upload was blocked.

data.title: Credential Harvesting via Fake SSO Portal
indicators: Multiple login attempts from attacker infrastructure
data.summary: Employees were directed to a counterfeit SSO portal designed to capture corporate credentials.
data.root_cause: A targeted phishing campaign used a compromised marketing account to send trusted-looking messages.
data.outcome: Five credentials were submitted, but MFA prevented successful account takeover.

data.title: Cryptomining on Cloud Instance
data.summary: A cloud account was used to launch an instance running cryptocurrency mining software.
data.root_cause: A leaked API key allowed an attacker to access the cloud environment.
data.outcome: The attacker incurred approximately £180 in cloud charges. No production data was accessed.

data.title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Persistence
indicators: Task created outside software deployment window
data.summary: Security monitoring detected a suspicious scheduled task configured to execute a binary at user logon.
data.root_cause: A trojanised installer was executed by an employee.
data.outcome: Persistence was removed before additional payloads were downloaded.

data.title: Exploitation of Unpatched VPN Appliance
data.summary: An internet-facing VPN appliance was exploited using a known vulnerability that had not yet been patched.
data.root_cause: The appliance remained on a vulnerable firmware version after a delayed maintenance window.
data.outcome: The attacker obtained temporary administrative access but no internal compromise was confirmed.

data.title: Mass Account Lockouts
data.summary: A malfunctioning application repeatedly attempted authentication using outdated credentials.
data.root_cause: A service configuration retained an old password after an account credential rotation.
data.outcome: No malicious activity was identified and normal authentication resumed.
lessons_learned: Alert on abnormal account lockout patterns

data.title: Malicious Browser Extension
data.summary: A browser extension installed by several employees was found to collect browsing information.
data.root_cause: Users installed an unapproved extension advertised as a productivity tool.
data.outcome: Browsing metadata may have been exposed. No corporate passwords were recovered by the extension.

data.title: DDoS Against Public API
indicators: Requests from thousands of source IPs
data.summary: The public API experienced a distributed denial-of-service attack causing intermittent service degradation.
data.root_cause: Attackers generated high-volume automated requests against an unauthenticated API endpoint.
data.outcome: API availability returned to normal after 52 minutes.
lessons_learned: Apply rate limits to public endpoints

data.title: Compromised Developer Account
data.summary: An attacker compromised a developer account and used it to access source code and CI/CD resources.
data.root_cause: The developer's session token was stolen from an infected workstation.
data.outcome: Several repositories were accessed. No malicious production deployment was completed.
lessons_learned: Protect developer endpoints with stronger controls

data.title: Sensitive Data Sent to Personal Email
data.summary: An employee accidentally emailed a spreadsheet containing customer information to a personal address.
data.root_cause: The employee selected an autocomplete recipient without noticing the incorrect address.
data.outcome: The recipient confirmed deletion and no further distribution was identified.
lessons_learned: Train staff to verify external recipients

data.title: Kerberoasting Activity
data.summary: Security monitoring detected abnormal Kerberos service ticket requests consistent with credential harvesting.
data.root_cause: A compromised employee workstation was used to request service tickets for offline password cracking.
data.outcome: No privileged account compromise was confirmed.

data.title: Internal Port Scanning
data.summary: A developer workstation performed broad internal network scanning outside normal testing activity.
data.root_cause: An unauthorised security scanning tool was executed on the workstation.
data.outcome: No exploitation followed the scanning activity.
lessons_learned: Restrict security tools to authorised systems

data.title: Business Email Compromise
data.summary: An executive mailbox was compromised and used to request an urgent supplier payment.
data.root_cause: The account was compromised after credentials were entered into a phishing page.
data.outcome: The fraudulent payment was stopped before funds were transferred.
lessons_learned: Require payment verification for unusual requests

data.title: Container Image with Critical Vulnerability
data.summary: A production container was found to use a base image containing a critical remotely exploitable vulnerability.
data.root_cause: The CI pipeline did not enforce vulnerability scanning before deployment.
data.outcome: No exploitation was detected before the vulnerable image was replaced.

data.title: Suspicious WMI Execution
data.summary: Security telemetry detected remote WMI execution from a compromised workstation.
data.root_cause: An attacker used stolen administrative credentials to move between internal systems.
data.outcome: Three servers were accessed but no persistent malware was found.

data.title: API Key Published to Public Repository
data.summary: A developer accidentally committed a cloud API key to a public repository.
data.root_cause: Secrets were stored directly in application configuration instead of a secret manager.
data.outcome: The key was publicly visible for 11 minutes. No unauthorised cloud activity was detected.

data.title: LDAP Enumeration from Workstation
data.summary: A workstation generated an unusual volume of LDAP queries against the corporate directory.
data.root_cause: A reconnaissance utility was executed after a workstation compromise.
data.outcome: Directory information was enumerated but no privileged changes were made.

data.title: Malicious Macro in Spreadsheet
data.summary: A malicious spreadsheet attachment attempted to execute code when opened by a finance employee.
data.root_cause: An attacker sent a weaponised spreadsheet disguised as an invoice.
data.outcome: The payload was blocked before persistence was established.

data.title: Privilege Escalation on Linux Server
data.summary: An application account was used to obtain elevated privileges on a Linux server.
data.root_cause: A misconfigured sudo rule allowed the application account to execute a privileged command without sufficient restrictions.
data.outcome: The attacker obtained root privileges briefly but did not access other servers.
lessons_learned: Apply least privilege to service accounts

data.title: Third-Party Supplier Account Compromise
indicators: Supplier account login from unusual IP
data.summary: A supplier account was compromised and used to access a restricted partner environment.
data.root_cause: The supplier account used password-only authentication and had a reused password.
data.outcome: The attacker downloaded internal documentation but no customer data was accessed.

data.title: Endpoint Data Wiper Detected
data.summary: Endpoint monitoring detected a destructive malware process attempting to delete local and shared files.
data.root_cause: A compromised administrator account was used to deploy a malicious executable.
data.outcome: Limited files were deleted before containment and were recovered from backups.

data.title: Fake Software Update Campaign
data.summary: Employees were redirected to a fake software update page that attempted to deliver malware.
data.root_cause: Malicious advertising content redirected users from a legitimate website.
data.outcome: Two employees downloaded the fake update but endpoint protection blocked execution.
lessons_learned: Educate users about browser update prompts

data.title: Cloud IAM Privilege Escalation
data.summary: An attacker attempted to elevate privileges within the cloud environment using a compromised developer identity.
data.root_cause: A permissive IAM policy allowed the developer role to modify its own permissions.
data.outcome: The attacker obtained administrative privileges for approximately eight minutes but did not modify production workloads.

data.title: Internal Phishing from Compromised Mailbox
data.summary: A compromised employee mailbox was used to send phishing messages to colleagues.
data.root_cause: The employee account was compromised through a previous external phishing campaign.
data.outcome: Seven employees clicked the link; MFA prevented account takeover in all cases.

data.title: Excessive Database Privileges
data.summary: A routine access review identified excessive database privileges assigned to an application account.
data.root_cause: Permissions from an earlier migration were never removed.
data.outcome: No misuse was identified and the application continued operating normally.

data.title: Malware Delivered Through Compromised Website
data.summary: Employees visiting a compromised external website were redirected toward malicious content.
data.root_cause: A third-party website had been compromised and injected with malicious scripts.
data.outcome: No successful endpoint compromise was confirmed.

data.title: Suspicious Data Transfer to External Storage
data.summary: Data loss prevention controls detected a large transfer of source code to an external storage service.
data.root_cause: An employee attempted to move project files to a personal account for convenience while working remotely.
data.outcome: The transfer was blocked before completion and no confirmed data loss occurred.

data.title: Credential Dumping on Domain Workstation
data.summary: Endpoint telemetry detected attempts to extract credentials from a domain-joined workstation.
data.root_cause: A privileged workstation was compromised through a malicious attachment.
data.outcome: Several user credentials may have been exposed, but no domain administrator credentials were recovered.

data.title: Unauthorised Firewall Rule Change
data.summary: A firewall rule unexpectedly exposed an internal service to the internet.
data.root_cause: An administrator account was compromised and used to modify firewall configuration.
data.outcome: The service was exposed for 27 minutes. No confirmed exploitation occurred.

data.title: Vulnerable Third-Party Library in Production
data.summary: A security scan identified a critical vulnerability in a third-party library used by a production application.
data.root_cause: Dependency updates were not automatically monitored after the application release.
data.outcome: No exploitation was detected before the dependency was patched.

data.title: SSH Brute Force Against Linux Server
data.summary: An internet-facing Linux server was subjected to automated SSH brute-force attempts.
data.root_cause: SSH password authentication remained enabled on a public server.
data.outcome: No successful login was identified.

data.title: Unauthorised Service Account Creation
data.summary: A previously unknown service account was discovered with elevated privileges.
data.root_cause: An attacker with administrative access created the account to maintain persistence.
data.outcome: No use of the account was observed after creation.

data.title: Cloud Storage Data Exposure
data.summary: A cloud storage container containing internal analytics data was accidentally configured for anonymous access.
data.root_cause: A manual configuration change bypassed the organisation's standard infrastructure-as-code deployment.
data.outcome: The data was exposed for approximately two hours. No confirmed download of sensitive records was identified.

data.title: Suspicious Remote Desktop Activity
data.summary: An administrator account connected to several Windows servers through RDP outside normal working hours.
data.root_cause: The administrator's credentials were stolen from an unmanaged personal device.
data.outcome: Four servers were accessed. No malicious configuration changes were found.
lessons_learned: Require managed devices for privileged access

data.title: Malicious OAuth Application Consent
data.summary: A user granted a malicious third-party application permission to access their corporate mailbox.
data.root_cause: The user approved an OAuth application after following a social-engineering link.
data.outcome: The application accessed a limited number of emails before permissions were revoked.

data.title: Backup System Access Attempt
data.summary: An attacker attempted to access the backup management system during a wider ransomware campaign.
data.root_cause: Credentials stolen from an administrative workstation were reused against the backup platform.
data.outcome: No backups were deleted or encrypted and recovery infrastructure remained available.

data.title: Data Exfiltration via DNS
data.summary: A compromised engineering workstation attempted to transmit system information through DNS queries.
data.root_cause: An information-stealing malware payload used DNS as a covert communication channel.
data.outcome: Host information was transmitted but no sensitive customer data was identified in the traffic.
